ai_summary: Hester Biosciences Limited reported strong standalone financial performance for Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing 14.4% year-over-year to INR 726.60 million and profit after tax surging 87.7% to INR 147.11 million, largely driven by exceptional growth in the Poultry Healthcare segment. However, the Animal Healthcare segment experienced a significant revenue decline of over 50% year-over-year and turned unprofitable, representing a material concern that contributed to an overall quarter-over-quarter decline in the company's financial results from Q4 FY26.
